coverage.notes: English is the standard medium of instruction with named bilingual university-course exceptions. The current international page lists 30 undergraduate programmes in four degree-offering faculties/schools, making full reproduction inappropriate for catalogue mode. Four illustrative, source-researched programmes were selected (one per unit); they are editorial examples, not officially labelled flagship degrees. Source pages are generally undated or relate to 2022, 2023, 2025/26 or 2026 entry; the 2027 international programme roster and application cycle are not verified. School of General Education and School of AI and Liberal Arts are mentioned on the institutional organisation page but are not distinct international undergraduate degree-category headings in the selected catalogue. The 2026 deadline and scholarships are retained strictly as historical. Institution type, location, degree awarding and English medium were checked against official sources.

institution.summary: English-medium liberal-arts university in Zhuhai, jointly founded by Beijing Normal University and Hong Kong Baptist University.

programmes.name: Artificial Intelligence
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Artificial Intelligence
programmes.language: Primarily English; WPEX and Healthy Lifestyle courses are bilingual (English/Chinese)
programmes.about: Study the computing and mathematical foundations of artificial intelligence, then develop models and intelligent applications through programming and projects.
programmes.overview: Students develop foundations in Python, computer systems, data structures and mathematics before studying machine learning, neural networks and optimisation. Workshop courses include robotics and practical machine-learning tools; the curriculum also provides applied projects and internship options. The programme description identifies applications in business and finance and in multimedia, although students should check the current cohort handbook for available concentrations. Its training is intended to support AI-related careers and postgraduate study.

programmes.name: Business Analytics
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Commerce (Honours) in Business Analytics
programmes.language: Primarily English; WPEX and Healthy Lifestyle courses are bilingual (English/Chinese)
programmes.about: Learn to use statistics, data mining and quantitative models to inform business decisions and address complex organisational problems.
programmes.overview: Business Analytics brings together management knowledge and quantitative tools for data-informed decisions. The published curriculum includes database management, business programming, operations research, R for statistics, data mining, optimisation and risk analysis. Students consider how analytical findings can be applied to marketing, logistics and other organisational settings. A final-year project develops research and communication skills, while the degree also includes university-wide and general education courses.

programmes.name: Game Design
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Creative Arts (Honours) in Game Design
programmes.language: Primarily English; WPEX and Healthy Lifestyle courses are bilingual (English/Chinese)
programmes.about: Combine interactive storytelling, programming, visual design and production skills to create digital games and related experiences.
programmes.overview: The programme combines creative practice with technical development in games. Its published courses cover drawing, programming, narrative and character design, digital graphics, 2D and 3D games, prototyping, game physics and production management. Students can explore virtual reality, generative-AI media workflows and other interactive technologies through specified coursework and electives. It aims to prepare graduates for game-production roles, adjacent creative technology work or further study; entry into the major may follow an initial journalism-and-communication admission category.

programmes.name: Globalisation and Development
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Social Sciences (Honours) in Globalisation and Development
programmes.language: Primarily English; WPEX and Healthy Lifestyle courses are bilingual (English/Chinese)
programmes.about: Investigate global development, public policy and international cooperation with social-science research and digital analytical methods.
programmes.overview: The degree connects political science, development economics and international relations with the study of sustainability and public policy. Published modules include research methods, social-science data analysis, digital transformation and environmental governance, alongside studies of the Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao Greater Bay Area. In later years students can pursue International Development or Public Administration, subject to enrolment and the cohort curriculum. The programme includes a final-year project and presents research, policy and international-organisation work as potential pathways.

faculties.name: Faculty of Business and Management
faculties.guidance: Nine business undergraduate programmes, spanning accounting, finance, economics, analytics and management. Overseas applicants are directed through BNBU international admissions; no separate 2027 faculty application rule was found.

faculties.name: School of Culture and Creativity
faculties.guidance: Creative undergraduate study in game design, film, animation, design, culture and music. The Game Design site describes entry through a broad Journalism and Communication category followed by major allocation; the route for 2027 international applicants needs confirmation.

faculties.name: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
faculties.guidance: Four-year English-taught honours programmes in languages, media, communication and social sciences. The faculty describes first-year FLL, SOC and JC admission categories for 2025/26; whether these apply to 2027 international admission is unconfirmed.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science and Technology
faculties.guidance: Nine undergraduate programmes in mathematical sciences, computing, statistics, data science and life sciences. International undergraduate applications use BNBU central admissions; no 2027 faculty-specific prerequisites were found.
